steps.message: Root cause: the "tidy up" commit changed 90 to 95, contradicting the documented 10% off.

arguments.command:
sed -i 's#base \* 95 / 100#base * 90 / 100#' bin/price && mkdir -p changes && printf 'ticket: CART-58

Restore the member price in bin/price to 10%% off (base * 90 / 100). The "price: tidy up" commit changed it to 95, which broke tests/price_test.sh.
' > changes/CART-58.md && git add bin/price changes/CART-58.md && git commit -q -m "[CART-58] fix price: restore 10% member discount

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && bash scripts/verify.sh; echo exit=$?; gh issue edit 31 --add-label needs-check
